capabilities: Open videos in VLC Player at a specified time via Obsidian URI links
Paste timestamped links of the current video position into the editor
Take and paste snapshot embeds from the current video frame
View .srt, .vtt, or .ass subtitles in a transcript view
Start Syncplay to control the VLC Player it opens
extras: Setup requires VLC's Web interface: on Windows you must select vlc.exe in settings, and the VLC Lua HTTP password and snapshot directory must be configured; VLC's Web port is fixed at 8080.
problem: Obsidian has no way to control an external video player or insert timestamp links and frame snapshots while watching a video.
summary: VLC integration that opens videos in VLC Player and pastes timestamped links and snapshots into notes.
